basis.factory_proxy_values: 6000 W input and 1000 N static thrust; 0.84 efficiency used only as engineering conversion to shaft-power cap, not an efficiency map.
basis.unverified: RPM, diameter proxy, reverse ratio, advance-thrust slope, torque limit, delays and all damping require actual propeller/motor/hull identification. Existing concept propeller differs from the factory propeller. No measured speed prediction.
basis.throttle_semantics: Signed normalized shaft-speed request, not normalized power. Deadband removed before mapping to RPM.
basis.scope: Low-speed calm-water manoeuvring; no propeller wake, cavitation, waves, added mass, propeller windmilling power recovery. Battery/fuel consumption and electrical limits are provided by the coupled usv_energy model.
